kind: Independent static review of root-authored round07 qa-storage-latency changes
executionScope: Read source and prepared JSON only; no import/execution of benchmark, no fixture generation, no browser or performance sample started.
samplingReview: Only declared warmup rows are excluded from statistics. All 24 measured rows must PASS; failure or BLOCKED stops and retains the attempted row, with no replacement, outlier rejection or partial-success statistics. Paired differences still match by pair number, independent of which version runs first.
stateReview: Fixture equality uses full object/encoding equality across both real APIs. Each timed PASS requires exactly two native writes in primary/mirror order; complete decoded main and mirror equal the true transition; raw strings, storage key set, settings and displayed lock are checked. Each version still refreshes its pair-12 state.
clockReview: Recorder block is byte-identical. Reflect.apply preserves original native setItem receiver/arguments/result/exception. All latency endpoints use the same in-page performance.now clock: trusted click, last original native return/throw, and second RAF. The later setTimeout only flushes records and releases the waiter. event.timeStamp is diagnostic only; host timestamps do not enter latency arithmetic. API return/RAF are explicitly not physical-disk durability, FPS or GPU timing.
servedVerificationReview: The per-variant list excludes only a recorded null optional inventory module. Existing served hash comparisons, page release/package version comparison, package.json HTTP 404, final disk snapshot and driver hash checks remain. Current inventory-dom is present and hashed; baseline missing inventory-dom is explicitly null.
limitations: Static review verifies code and prepared artifact only; no browser outcome, sample distribution or speedup is established.
The source inventory is the explicitly declared sourcePaths list; this review does not claim every repository file is frozen.
